question.content: In a study of 1000 people, investigators observed who was bitten by a flea and who subsequently developed plague. 600 people were bitten by a flea. 400 out of 600 people developed plague. 400 people have never been bitten by a flea, 100 out of them developed plague. What's the relative risk of people with flea bitten developing plague?
